ui.wizard.title: First-run wizard
ui.wizard.intro: Three steps to an image: (1) pick the run mode (embedded by default; ComfyUI is fetched for you) (2) pick a model tier (minimal by default, ~5.24 GB — exactly the default generation model) (3) press start. The runtime (portable Node / 7-Zip / ComfyUI / llama.cpp) is provisioned automatically, each component has several China-friendly mirrors, and a source that stalls for 10 s is swapped out.

ui.settings.window.noTray.detail: The standalone build is a plain browser page plus a local backend process; there is no tray process, so "minimize to tray on start" and "close-button behaviour" do not apply and are intentionally not offered. To quit, close the launcher window or press Ctrl+C in it.

ui.llm.provider.title: Inference source
ui.llm.provider.hint: The external API is chat-only: one system prompt plus the last N messages, no tools/kernels. The API key is stored only in data/settings.json (never committed).
ui.llm.catalog.title: Recommended models (one-click download)
ui.llm.catalog.hint: Recommended order: 9B (best quality) → 4B (already on disk, best balance) → 2B (smallest). Sizes, sha256 and licences were checked upstream; links are the primary path here, and downloading still works (sha256 is verified after download).
ui.llm.characters.title: Character index (Danbooru character tags)
ui.llm.characters.hint: Measured conclusion: no text LLM that fits 8 GB VRAM reliably turns a name like 蕾姆/Rem into the canonical character tag. So a deterministic index does it: resolve the name, then check/repair the model output.
ui.llm.characters.added: Character tags added from the index
ui.llm.characters.fixed: Character tags rewritten to canonical form
ui.settings.llm.apiBase.hint: e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1 or http://127.0.0.1:8199/v1 (a local llama-server works too)
ui.settings.llm.apiKey.hint: Written only to <project root>\data\settings.json (gitignored); never logged or shipped.
ui.settings.download.useModelScope: Rewrite HuggingFace links to ModelScope automatically (usually fastest in China)
ui.settings.download.stall.hint: Below this we switch source; the final candidate is allowed to finish as long as it makes progress
ui.settings.download.officialFirst: Official source first (default off: usually unreachable in China, mirrors are faster)
ui.settings.download.presetCn.hint: ModelScope + aifasthub + hf-mirror + verified GitHub proxies (gh-proxy / ghproxy.net / ghfast.top)
ui.settings.speed.title: Mirror speed test (100 MiB each)
ui.settings.speed.hint: Downloads a chunk from every candidate source of the URL above and reports first-byte time and speed. This is the on-the-spot check of the "switch source when nothing happens within 10 s" rule; nothing is written to disk.
ui.settings.speed.slow: slow but still downloading (hit the per-source cap)
ui.settings.llm.apiModel.hint: Model ids fetched from the service; just pick one
ui.settings.llm.apiMaxTokens.hint: Reasoning models (deepseek-flash and friends) spend this budget on thinking first: too small and the body comes back empty. Default 4096.
ui.settings.llm.apiThinking.hint: Disabling thinking makes the body more reliable and faster (verified with DeepSeek); some services do not know the field, so you can hand it back to the server.
ui.settings.llm.apiModelUnknown: This model id is not in the list returned by the service
ui.settings.llm.apiHint: Use the root URL (https://api.deepseek.com, with or without /v1). The key is stored only in data/settings.json — never in the repo, logs or shipped docs.
ui.llm.provider.apiNeedKey: The external API still has no key: paste it in Settings → Local LLM → external API (DeepSeek URL and model are pre-filled), or switch the source back to the local 4B model.
ui.llm.reasoning.label: Reasoning
ui.llm.reasoning.hint: External API only; measured reasoning_tokens: off 0 / low 620 / high 635 / max 1459
ui.llm.ctx.toggle: Send context to the model (off by default)
ui.llm.ctx.hint: When off, the history stays in the UI for reading and copying, and only the current message is sent.
ui.llm.ctx.on: History is sent to the model
ui.llm.ctx.off: History stays local and is not sent to the model
ui.llm.copyAll.hint: Copy every user/assistant message of this session as one text block
ui.artists.works.title: Local works (by artist)
ui.artists.works.hint: Images found in the local output folder (including <model>\ subfolders); the artist tag is parsed the same way the panel does it.
ui.artists.works.placeholder: Artist name (@name) or keyword, Enter to search
ui.settings.llm.apiReasoning.hint: off = no thinking (default, fastest); low/high/max send reasoning_effort. Measured reasoning_tokens: off 0 / low 620 / high 635 / max 1459.
ui.settings.llm.sendContext.hint: Off by default: the UI keeps the full history (copyable), while only the current message is sent.
ui.job.openHint: Click to see background job progress (it survives page switches; jobs run on the server)
ui.wizard.lowbarrier: Low barrier by design: unzip and double-click start.cmd; it fetches whatever is missing; if you already have ComfyUI or models locally you can point at them (hardlink import, no extra disk).
